question: Who oversees the administrative functions of the Panchayat Samiti?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Block Development Officer**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Block Development Officer** oversees the administrative functions of the Panchayat Samiti.
 
• The Block Development Officer (BDO) plays a crucial role in the implementation of development programs at the block level.
 
• The BDO acts as a link between the government and the Panchayat Samiti, ensuring that policies and schemes are executed efficiently.
 
• The BDO is responsible for coordinating with various departments and ensuring the smooth functioning of the Panchayat Samiti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Panchayat Samiti** is a rural local government body at the intermediate level in the Panchayati Raj system.
 
• It works for the villages of the tehsil or taluka that together are called a development block.
 
• Each Panchayat Samiti is headed by a Chairman and has members elected from various Panchayats within the block.
 
• The primary function of the Panchayat Samiti is to plan and execute development programs for the block.
 
• It acts as a coordinating body between the Village Panchayats and the Zila Parishad (District Council).
